summary: 3M Company filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) on September 3, 2026, for a proposed offering of three series of senior unsecured notes with maturities in 20—. The filing is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The notes will rank equally with existing unsecured indebtedness, are redeemable at 3M's option, and are expected to be listed on the NYSE. Proceeds and interest rates are not yet finalized. The offering is subject to completion and priced via underwriters including Deutsche Bank, BofA Securities, Citigroup, and J.P. Morgan. No special-situation event is indicated.
